definitions.explanation: A dark, rich shade of green. Used to describe colors in nature, clothing, and design.

examples.japanese: {深緑|ふかみどり}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{森|もり}→森：02260_mori⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がっている→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧。
examples.english: A deep green forest stretches out.

examples.japanese: {深緑|ふかみどり}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦コート→コート：01358_kooto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought a dark green coat.
In summer, the mountain trees turn deep green.

notes:
A traditional Japanese color name describing a rich, dark shade of green. Evokes the lush greenery of midsummer forests.

FORMS:
{深|ふか} (deep) + ⟦{緑|みどり}→緑：00970_midori⟧ (green)

SIMILAR COLOR TERMS:
- ⟦{新緑|しんりょく}→新緑：12724_shinryoku⟧: fresh green (of new spring leaves) — lighter and brighter
- {若緑|わかみどり}: young green — a light, yellowish green of early growth
- ⟦{濃緑|のうりょく}→濃緑：24868_nouryoku⟧: dense/dark green — more technical, used in color specifications
- {萌黄|もえぎ}: yellowish green — a lighter, more vivid traditional color

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {深緑|ふかみどり}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{季節|きせつ}→季節：01304_kisetsu⟧: the season of deep green (midsummer)
- {深緑|ふかみどり}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{染|そ}まる→染まる：04254_somaru⟧: to be dyed deep green
- {深緑|ふかみどり}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{葉|は}→葉：02241_ha⟧: deep green leaves
